name: Titus Mission Pack
description: The Lieutenant Titus Mission Pack is a spin-off of Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team. Its parent game includes an expanded range of detailed miniatures, evocative terrain and unique rules. Fight tactical battles against opponents with your team of elite operatives, all set within the grim darkness of the far future.

operatives.name: Lieutenant Titus
operatives.abilities:
Lethal Parry: Whenever this operative is retaliating, before resolving attack dice in Step 4 of the fight sequence, if you have any critical successes, you can immediately resolve one of them (before the NPO resolves any).

Righteous Fury: Player operatives within 6" of this operative regain up to D3+3 lost wounds (roll separately for each), then remove all Mortal Wound tokens from those operatives.  
 This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle.

operatives.name: Gadriel
operatives.abilities:
Battle Cry: Inflict D3+3 damage on each enemy operative within 3" of this operative (roll separately for each).  
This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle.

Lethal Parry: Whenever this operative is retaliating, before resolving attack dice in Step 4 of the fight sequence, if you have any critical successes, you can immediately resolve one of them (before the NPO resolves any).

operatives.name: Chairon
operatives.abilities:
Auspex Scan: Until the end of this operative's next activation, whenever a player operative is shooting, fighting or retaliating, add 1 to the Critical Dmg stat of its weapons, and its successes equal to or greater than 5 are critical successes.  
This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle.

Lethal Parry: Whenever this operative is retaliating, before resolving attack dice in Step 4 of the fight sequence, if you have any critical successes, you can immediately resolve one of them (before the NPO resolves any).

operatives.name: Hormagaunt
operatives.abilities:
Behavior: 1. Fight.  

2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.  

3. Reposition towards the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.  

4. Dash towards the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.

operatives.name: Termagant
operatives.abilities:
Behavior: 1. Fall Back. If possible, to a location where there’s a valid target.  

2. Reposition towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible. Additionally, to a location where there’s a valid target if possible.  

3. Shoot.  

4. Dash towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.  

5. Fight

operatives.name: Tyranid Warrior
operatives.abilities:
Behavior: 1. Fight  

2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.  

3. Shoot the closest player operative.  

4. Reposition towards the closest player operative.  

5. Dash towards the closest player operative.

Synapse: Whenever a Hormagaunt or Termagant NPO is shooting or fighting within 3" of this operative, retain one attack dice as a normal success for that operative without rolling it.

Synaptic Backlash: Whenever this operative is incapacitated, before it is removed from the killzone, inflict D3 damage on each Hormagaunt and Termagant within 3" of it (roll separately for each).

operatives.name: Lictor
operatives.abilities:
Behavior: 1. Fight.  

2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.  

3. Reposition towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible (a subsequent Dash action can fulfil this, if able).  

4. Dash towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.

Hiddden Predator: After this operative performs the Fight action, it immediately performs a free Fall Back action, to cover if possible. Whenever this operative is in cover from a player operative, it is not visible to that player operative.
